name: aVinceLaunch
description: Organize, access, launch: a lightweight desktop organizer with fences and launcher groups for Linux Mint Cinnamon.
comments:
aVinceLaunch turns ordinary folders of .desktop files, documents and subfolders into tidy groups on your desktop.

Organize links the way you already think about them - work, utilities, graphics, or any structure you choose. Each instance points at its own folder, with in-place folder navigation, custom order and pinning, snapping, collapsing and search, locks for position, size and content, automatic sizing and group titles that stay readable on any wallpaper.

- Natural, configurable organization - build a launcher layout from real directories instead of burying shortcuts in menus.
- A cleaner desktop - keep clutter off the wallpaper and put your apps in one place you control.
- Everything at your fingertips - launch what you need instantly instead of searching through application lists.

Copy files into your link folder or manage items from the Configure dialog. The filesystem is the source of truth; aVinceLaunch keeps the display in sync.
